name: The Minimal Cell
description: Fig 8b — the minimal cell: the three columns of Fig 8a wired into one composite. Four processes — containment (lipids→membrane), metabolism (enzymes+nutrients→metabolites+energy), gene expression (genes→proteins+enzymes), and replication (genes+energy→gene copies) — are coupled through shared pools, with generic diffusion and mass-action reactions keeping the building-block stores supplied. Metabolism powers replication and expression supplies metabolism's enzymes: this mutual dependence through shared components is the minimal form of autopoietic closure. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no update dynamics.
